cc:Work.dc:title: Co-Design Bench overview
cc:Work.dc:description: Co-Design Bench contains 273 evaluation tasks and 2,331 criteria: 100 Multimodal Editing tasks (96 publicly released) and 173 Repository Editing tasks (not released). Runnable task inputs lead to iterative agent revisions, source and browser evidence, and judge-then-refute evaluation against hidden acceptance criteria. PASS, PARTIAL and FAIL verdicts are aggregated into Strict, Graded and Full-pass metrics.
